TREATMENT OF URINARY TRACT CALCULI
Treatment Goals
- Relieve symptoms
- Remove stones
- Prevent recurrence
Non-drug Treatment
- Increased fluid intake
- Endoscopic Short Wave Lithotripsy (ESWL)
- Endoscopic removal of stones
- Open surgical removal
Drug Treatment
- Analgesics
- Antibiotics to treat infections
- Drugs used to prevent recurrence:
- Thiazide diuretics
- Hydrochorothiazide 5 mg orally daily
Or:
- Potassium citrate 60 mEq orally daily

Or:
- Allopurinol 100 mg orally daily
